annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家卫生健康委员会 (National Health Commission)
key_provisions_or_claims: Provincial health authorities organise centralized procurement of Class B large medical equipment for all public institutions, completing at least one round by end of 2026.
Each province must pilot city-level centralized procurement in at least one city by June 2027.
Health authorities designate one non-profit implementing agency to run procurement under entrustment agreements.
Provinces file work plans with the NHC by June 2026 and report annually in December.
Supersedes the 2007 notice; prevails over inconsistent 2012 and 2013 procurement rules.
annotation.summary_en: Chinese National Health Commission notice (2026) on centralized procurement of public-sector medical equipment, requiring provincial centralized procurement of Class B large equipment and city-level pilots, designating implementing agencies, setting reporting duties, and replacing earlier 2007 procurement rules. Not AI-related.
